lines.vo: We took every angle out of this master bath, and redid the main bath too.

square jetted tub and angled shower against the freestanding tub

the walnut and pink resin bath table across the tub

lines.vo: Stick around, and I'll tell you what it cost and how long it took.

shower wall and niche under the tease card
